summary: Plan the arithmetic applications of balanced-module patching in defect one to torsion weight-one forms over Q and to PGL₂ homology over imaginary quadratic fields. Construct the required Hecke and coefficient data, prove unramified weight-one local–global compatibility, and deduce minimal R = T with its precise rank and finite-image consequences. Import the patching algebra and local deformation rings from their owners. Keep the general scalar multiplicity theorem, 3-primary Bianchi orbifold extension and integral principal-type repair as explicit mathematical gaps.

nodes.title: Weight-one level data
nodes.statement: For p≥3, O the integers of a finite extension K/Q_p, uniformizer π and residue field k, fix odd absolutely irreducible continuous barρ:G_Q→GL₂(k), unramified at p, with prime-to-p Artin conductor N. A level datum consists of the conductor-level Katz/descent object X, a fixed auxiliary prime r≥5 away from Np with r≢1 mod p and residual Frobenius eigenvalue ratio different from r and r⁻¹, a finite set Q disjoint from Npr, chosen distinct residual roots α_x,β_x for x∈Q, and a p-power quotient Δ of ∏_{x∈Q}(Z/xZ)×. Write X₀(Q), X₁(Q), X_Δ(Q) for the corresponding imported curves over O. The prime r is removed only by the selected-oldform comparison; it is not a Taylor–Wiles variable. At each ramified x with barρ|D_x reducible require barρ^{I_x}≠0, the standing hypothesis of §3.1. At conductor level quotient Γ₁(N) by the p-primary diamond subgroup H_N; use its genuine Katz/descent object, not a coarse Hodge line without descent. The fine rigidified model has extra Γ₁(r) level, denoted X^(r). Statements at conductor level mean the module recovered from this model by the harmless-prime comparison (one or two old copies); the fine model and the conductor object are not identified.

The weight-one residual representation is continuous, odd, absolutely irreducible and unramified at p; at a ramified reducible decomposition group its inertia invariants are nonzero. Determinant-normalized minimal lifts have Teichmüller determinant.

Apply Chebotarev through R04.5 to the full residual representation together with the cyclotomic character to choose r. Unramifiedness of barρ at p supplies the required disjointness.
Specialize the standard level functors and p-power diamond quotient; keep Q empty and Δ=1 valid.

Use the R15.1 representability/descent contract and the D1.1 harmless-prime comparison to transport conclusions to conductor level. A repeated auxiliary root gives two old copies; divide the defect inequality by two, rather than calling this a one-copy selected factor.

nodes.title: Minimal Bianchi datum

At levels with no P primes, the map R_min→T_{m_∅} is an isomorphism and H₁(Y,O)_{m_∅} is nonzero finite free over it. The corrected minimal-type version with P primes has the same conclusion provided its integral projector/Hecke/duality/Conjecture A package is supplied (Gap P). The intended p=3 theorem requires Gap O to be resolved. O-flatness of H or T is not an assumption.

nodes.title: Minimal semistable Bianchi modularity lifting
nodes.statement: Let p≥5 be unramified in imaginary quadratic F. Assume Conjecture A for all auxiliary levels. Let ρ:G_F→GL₂(O) be continuous, determinant ε, unramified outside finitely many places, semistable at every finite place (unipotent inertia away from p), and at each v|p finite flat or ordinary. Suppose barρ|G_{F(ζ_p)} is absolutely irreducible, barρ occurs in mod-p homology at its minimal level N(barρ), and ρ satisfies the minimal local conditions including finite-flat precedence. Then ρ is associated to a regular algebraic cuspidal GL₂/F representation π with matching unramified local factors and L-function under the fixed normalization. At p=3 the stated target additionally depends on Gap O.

nodes.title: GL/PGL class-group obstruction
nodes.statement: PGL₂ removes the odd p-primary unramified central-character twists that would remain in the same residual GL₂ Hecke factor. If such twists are modeled by a cyclic C_p, their universal character algebra O[C_p] has O-rank p and cannot be the image of the scalar coefficient map O→O[C_p]. This algebraic obstruction explains the source’s expected GL example; no unconditional automorphic isomorphism T=O[C_p] is asserted. In a GL ray-class replacement, for a class a of order h=p^b with a^h=(α), splitting the ray-class extension requires the h-th-power Kummer condition α^{(N(x)−1)/h}≡1 at primes with h|N(x)−1, equivalently the corresponding splitting in F(α^{1/h},ζ_h). A p-th-power condition alone is insufficient when b>1.

gaps.title: Gap M — nonharmless twisting collision in scalar multiplicity
gaps.detail: At x≡1 mod p with a ramified nonsplit self-extension of an unramified residual character, the determinant-normalizing ψ^{-1/2} twist can identify two distinct conductor-minimal characteristic-zero automorphic lifts (the ψ and ψ^{-1} choices). Thus the printed fixed-determinant generic-fibre map in Theorem 4.8, p. 363, need not be injective. To obtain the unrestricted multiplicity-two theorem, construct the conductor≤1 local deformation ring with variable p-primary inertial determinant over the local diamond algebra, patch that ring/module with its matching types, and prove its Cohen–Macaulay type is still three after the global parameter quotient. The source proves none of these repairs. D1.7 gives the matched restricted version and the general theorem as an unresolved target. Extraction lead: PAPER-CALEGARI-GERAGHTY-18/E85; this plan does not certify the general statement.

gaps.title: Gap O — localized 3-primary orbifold homology
gaps.detail: At p=3 the fixed arithmetic levels can have order-three stabilizers; group/orbifold H₃ is not zero merely because the coarse quotient is a noncompact three-manifold. Prove the 3-primary Farrell/stabilizer homology vanishes at the selected residual ideals and establish the resulting localized boundary/duality package compatibly at all Taylor–Wiles levels. A possible approach is to identify its Hecke systems as induced from F(ζ₃), then use the absolute irreducibility after restriction hypothesis; that identification is not proved here. Non-Eisensteinness alone does not exclude irreducible induced systems, and the fixed Γ₀ Taylor–Wiles levels need not admit the required torsion-free replacement. Results here use p≥5 or this additional package. Extraction lead: PAPER-CALEGARI-GERAGHTY-18/E116.

gaps.title: Gap P — integral minimal type at Bianchi principal primes
gaps.detail: The printed Γ_p(v^{a(barρ)}) level at type P contains nonminimal inertial lifts. Its correction needs both local type selection and a compatible integral homology model: for ψ²≠1 use the half-conductor ψ character type, and for ψ²=1 use the ψ∘det twisted spherical type. Supply the integral projector/local-system construction, base-change and duality, compatibility with the auxiliary covers and Hecke correspondences, and Conjecture A on these exact spaces. Local characteristic-zero newvector calculations alone do not give that package. This pass proves the no-P Bianchi formulation conditionally on Conjecture A, and states the corrected general one with this explicit input. Extraction leads: PAPER-CALEGARI-GERAGHTY-18/E106,E121.
